comments.text:
Iam from Kenya in East Africa. These videos have made me realize why East Africa and west Africa are so different in terms of geography, culture and religion.
Most of West Africa is a few meters above Sea level and the average temperatures are high.
Most of Kenya is in highland (my area is 2600m asl) and it's cold.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: That's a sharp observation — altitude changes everything. Your 2,600 m is higher than anywhere in Guinea, though Guinea has its own uplands: the Fouta Djallon highlands, where the Niger, Senegal and Gambia rivers begin.
